placeholders.Inspection: Visual inspection: posture, alignment, deformity, skin, surgical sites, atrophy, swelling.
placeholders.Palpation: Palpation: tenderness, warmth, crepitus, masses. Not visually assessable if not documented.
placeholders.Active Range of Motion: Active ROM: document planes and degrees or comparison to contralateral.
placeholders.Passive Range of Motion: Passive ROM: end feel, blocks, pain at limit.
placeholders.Strength: Motor strength: grade 0–5 or comparison. Not visually assessable if not demonstrated.
placeholders.Special Tests: Special tests: e.g. impingement, instability, provocative maneuvers. Document positive/negative.
placeholders.Neurovascular: Neurovascular: sensation, pulses, capillary refill. Not visually assessable if not demonstrated.
placeholders.Swelling/Effusion: Swelling or effusion. Not visually assessable if not applicable.
placeholders.Skin/Scarring: Skin condition, scars, healing. Not visually assessable if not applicable.
